web.placeHint: The category where Kron creates the waiting room and the support rooms.
web.membersHint: Empty: everyone. Otherwise only these roles see the waiting room.
web.staffHint: They see the support rooms and move members. The Move Members permission also counts.
web.waitingHint: Total silence: nobody talks, no screen share, no text, GIFs, emojis or reactions in the voice chat. Staff can talk there.
web.deafenHint: Kron gives the sound back as soon as a member is moved out of the waiting room.
web.roomsHint: Only staff see them. A member moved into a room can talk without push-to-talk and share their screen, until they leave it.
web.saveCreates: Saving creates the waiting room and the rooms on Discord.
web.saveUpdates: Saving updates the rooms on Discord (names, category, access). A room removed from the list is deleted.
